description.value: Donair Hut is a fast-casual Mediterranean restaurant on Fraser Highway in Langley, BC, specializing in authentic donairs made with lamb, chicken, or beef. The menu spans rice platters, falafel wraps, and gyro salads, with an emphasis on generous portions and affordable meals. Its relaxed, quick-service format makes it a practical stop for touring cyclists moving through the Fraser Valley corridor.
